body: claimed: SKULL issue-worker-max (claude-fable-5-2) · 2026-11-13T21:53Z · worktree/branch issue/1548-bspline-corner-blends · plan: stacked on PR #1546; own bounded parametric tessellation for B-spline/NURBS faces truck cannot divide, pinned on a three-fillet corner fixture

fix on issue/1548-bspline-corner-blends · PR #1574 · pinned by import_step_corner_blend (a_three_fillet_corner_imports_closed_at_its_volume_within_the_chord_tolerance, edges_declared_against_their_curves_import_the_same_closed_solid, bent_corner_blends_end_cleanly_and_bounded) and step_pole's unit tests · merges when reviewed

Root cause, measured on a rebuild of the #1536 part (solidcore, 62 faces / 126 edges / 66 vertices, same refusal as PR #1546 reported): the blends are continuous. They are rational patches with one side collapsed to the corner vertex. At that pole truck's parameter search returned the free parameter as -1,195,342,517 (knot domain 0..1), and truck then subdivided the bounding box of the boundary's parameters, a billion knot spans of extrapolation, which never converges. Behind it was a second fault: the rounded edges are surface curves with a pcurve master, which truck rebuilds in its own parametrisation; with the pole fixed alone the model imported at 13,981 mm3 of 19,549.7 with no refusal. Both are fixed at our wrapper; truck's subdivision is kept. The rebuild now imports closed at 19,545.21 mm3.

Not exercised: the user's own `sc_logo.step` (not available here; its writer differs from the rebuild's). Please re-run the #1536 repro on a build of the branch.

Follow-up filed: #1573 (P1), a closed shell that meshes open still imports with no refusal.
